notes:
Summary: Sienna Arc is a mid-market SaaS vendor (support platform for SMBs) evaluating Redwood hosted API to power a KB-based RAG layer. Primary focus: embeddings + reranking to improve answer precision for short customer-support queries. They expect moderate index scale but sustained high QPS from their multi-tenant frontend.

Technical constraints / targets (customer quotes and paraphrases):
- Indexing scale: planning ~3M documents initially (mix of short KB articles and long troubleshooting guides). Typical doc length ~150–400 tokens. Expected growth ~20% qtrly.
- Query volume: high QPS target: steady-state 1k–1.5k QPS during business hours; spikes to 3k+ for incidents.
- Latency SLO: p95 target <120ms ("must hit <120ms p95 or UX will reject"). p50 target <40ms.
- Reranking: candidate generation via ANN (k=30–50) + cross-encoder reranker for top 10. Want tradeoff analysis: CPU cost for reranker vs. improved click-through.
- Embedding model: prefer open/verified embeddings; dimension 1536 suggested by their analytics team.
- Cost sensitivity: high; procurement expects <$0.002–0.005 per successful query (end-to-end, including ANN + rerank amortized).

POC scope / acceptance criteria:
- Ingest 3M doc sample, maintain live delta updates (bulk + incremental).
- Serve 24h perf ramp to 1.2k QPS with measured p50/p95/p99 and cost per query.
- Demonstrate fallback to cheaper model variant and prefix caching to show graceful degradation.

Integrations / references: Zendesk for source sync, BigQuery for metadata, Auth via SAML SSO.

Open questions / sales notes:
- Need concrete cost model showing cost/QPS for (A) ANN-only, (B) ANN + lightweight reranker, (C) ANN + heavy cross-encoder. Customer will benchmark and compare to in-house vector DB costs.
- Legal wants data residency options for EU tenants; ask infra about region pinning for hosted API offerings.
- Feature ask: per-route token/usage breakdown in console to attribute costs per tenant — important for their internal chargebacks.
